@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: Send the live toolCall and running toolStatus events when the call starts, not at the end of the submission
+---
+## What
+The write-ahead card (01M6GK7RHHHC6B6QMJ25FT1QDT) records a `.toolCallStarted` marker when a tool call starts. The live `toolCall` and running `toolStatus` events still go out at the END of the submission (`emitSessionEvents` in `Session/RoutedSessionActorRecording.swift`). A host that shows progress sees a call only after it ended.
+
+An early version of this change failed 4 existing tests: `SessionObserverSeedingTests` (grouped rows) and `ToolInvocationLivenessTests` (event order). Cause: `SessionObserver` closes the narration text of a pass only when the open text row is the last row. An early call row stops the narration from joining its call group.
+
+## Do (design first, in a task comment)
+1. Change `SessionObserver` so an early call row does not break the grouping of narration text with its calls (group by pass, not by row order).
+2. Emit `toolCall` and a running `toolStatus` from the started-marker path (`RoutedSessionActor.deliver(invocation:)`), once per call id. The end-of-submission diff skips the ids already emitted (keep a set of started ids).
+3. Update the tests that assert the event order, with a reason for each change.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A host sees `toolCall` and running `toolStatus` when the call starts.
+- [ ] No call is announced twice.
+- [ ] The observer rows group the same as before for a clean run.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Extend `ToolInvocationLivenessTests` and `SessionObserverSeedingTests`. Run the full `swift test`.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file

forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -1,6 +1,19 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m6haa3m9qmhneje56y8zgp95
+  text: |-
+    ### Design (before code)
+    Cause: SessionObserver marks the narration of a pass as superseded only when the open text row is the LAST row (markOpenTextRowSuperseded). A call row that comes early is then the last row, so the narration is not superseded and does not join its call group.
+
+    Plan:
+    1. SessionObserver. A textReset marks the last open text row as superseded, and it skips open (unstamped) call rows at the end of the transcript. A pass is the unit, not the row order. The rows are not moved: the order of rows after canonical ordering stays the same as for a clean run.
+    2. RoutedSessionActor. New set `announcedToolCallIDs`. In deliver(invocation:), after recordStart succeeds for a call, if the id is not in the set: insert it, send toolCall and running toolStatus (deliverPost, the same path as the toolInvocation event), then send toolInvocation(open). The toolCall event comes first so the toolCallID of the record names a call that the host already knows.
+    3. RoutedSessionActorRecording.emitSessionEvents. For a .toolCalls partial, a call id in the set is not announced again (no toolCall, no running toolStatus), but it still joins dispatchedToolCallIds, so the pairing of outputs and the failed status for a call without output stay the same. The id leaves the set when the diff uses it. A call with no marker is announced at the end, as before.
+    4. Tests update: the order tests in ToolInvocationLivenessTests (toolCall now before open). A reason for each change is in a later comment.

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m6hajx9vq2kz3c37ayb56dks
+  text: |-
+    ### Test changes and reasons
+    - ToolInvocationLivenessTests.liveInvocationEventArrivesWhileTheToolStillRuns: the order was "close, then toolCall, then completed". It is now "toolCall, then open, then close, then completed". Reason: the host gets toolCall when the call starts, before the open record of the call, so the toolCallID of the record names a known call. The completed status still comes from the diff at the end.
+    - New: ToolInvocationLivenessTests.callIsAnnouncedWhenItStartsAndOnlyOneTime. The host has toolCall and running toolStatus while the tool still runs (gate closed), and the diff does not announce the call again (one toolCall, one running status).
+    - New: SessionObserverSeedingTests.earlyCallRowKeepsTheNarrationInItsCallGroup. With an early call row, the grouped rows of the live observer equal the grouped rows of the seeded observer. It failed before the observer fix (the narration stayed a top-level row).
+    - Helper oneCallScript gets an `id` parameter with default "call-1"; the other callers did not change.
+    - SessionObserverSeedingTests.groupedRowsOfASeededProjectionEqualTheLiveProjections and SessionObserverTests did not need a change: the clean-run order is the same as before.
+    - Full swift test: 2342 tests (282 suites) + 38 (23 suites) + 19 (3 suites), all passed, zero issues.
+
+    ### implement — changed
+    - evidence: Session/SessionObserver.swift, Session/RoutedSessionActor.swift, Session/RoutedSessionActorRunJournal.swift, Session/RoutedSessionActorRecording.swift, Tests/.../SessionObserverSeedingTests.swift, Tests/.../ToolInvocationLivenessTests.swift. swift test: all pass.
+    - undecided: (a) a call id in announcedToolCallIDs leaves the set only when a diff with a sink uses it; with a nil sink, or a call that never reaches a transcript diff (rolled-back attempt), the id stays and the host keeps a running row (no failed status). (b) the toolCall/running events use deliverPost, the same path as the toolInvocation event.
